purpose: Outfit selection inferred from the user-supplied in-game Kestron capture; these selectors are external to the ShareMii payload

selection_scope.source: visual match against the title's complete cloth catalog plus Cloth/ClothModelParam RSDB rows
selection_scope.color_variation_evidence: The lime base, pale doodle line art, green ribbed sock cuff, and standard shoe upper/sole match variation 10 across all three selected projects. World lighting makes the captured surfaces darker and warmer than their unlit albedo.
selection_scope.not_claimed: The clothing IDs and variation are not encoded anywhere in the 434-byte mii1.ltd file. They are an external capture-derived presentation state.

items.visual_evidence: Exact round collar, oversized short-sleeve silhouette, four-panel UV layout, lime field, and white abstract doodle pattern.
The captured green ankle sock and its darker ribbed cuff match the variation-10 albedo on BodyBaseDefault's Socks shape.
The simple rounded green upper, pale sole, and standard low shoe proportions match this model and variation.

current_renderer_boundary.geometry: Exact BFRES geometry, exact IconPose skinning, and exact Kestron body scale
current_renderer_boundary.textures: All ten selected albedo/normal/material-information/skin-mask surfaces have exact native BNTX mip chains cataloged (90 levels total); the compiled top, bottoms, and shoe programs omit their serialized _alp0 assignments, so those alpha-mask surfaces are inactive evidence rather than runtime opacity inputs
current_renderer_boundary.materials: Top body GameAll 984, bottoms body GameAll 936, shoes GameAll 912, and BodyBaseDefault BodyFoot socks GameAll 324 are cataloged by the checked outfit/body program ledgers; local active albedo/normal/roughness inputs are reproduced, top/bottom Softmesh program 36 is skipped fail-closed, and environment-dependent GameUber lobes remain bounded below
current_renderer_boundary.lighting: Portable GameUber approximation; the reference capture's environment/light/static-shadow buffers are not reproduced
current_renderer_boundary.pose: IconPose is a deterministic preview pose, not the world-idle pose visible in the capture
